chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, son of Yahya, from Ahmad, son of Muhammad, from Ali, son of Al-Hakam, from Al-'Ala', son of Razin, from Muhammad, son of Muslim, from one of the two Imams (peace be upon them)...

...regarding the man who dies while having a wife under him whom he had not entered (consummated the marriage with). He (peace be upon him) said: For her is half the dower, and for her is the complete inheritance, and upon her is the complete waiting period.
ai.seo_question: What are the rights of a widow if her husband dies before consummating the marriage?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the juristic status of a widow whose husband died prior to consummation, establishing that she retains full inheritance rights as a wife while receiving only half of the stipulated dower. The requirement to observe the complete iddah of four months and ten days distinguishes this case from divorce, reflecting the principle that the marital bond was fully established even without physical union. This ruling is foundational in Shia fiqh for determining the financial and temporal obligations of the deceased's estate and the widow.
